1 · Intro

When to use it.

Most position problems come from reusing old positions and a few easy-to-miss fields. These habits keep positions clean, approvals fast, and the data that flows to the hire correct.

Use this whenYou manage positions for your business unit and want to avoid send-backs.

HCM Academy job aid · Position Management

Position management best practices

Use when: You manage positions for your business unit and want to avoid send-backs. · System: Overview

  1. Create new; don't reactivate or repurpose.
  2. Use six-digit job codes only.
  3. Get the memo first.
  4. Standard working hours are always 40.
  5. Leave Manager blank on the position.
  6. Set the real location.
  7. Fix the position before the requisition.
  8. Keep documents on the position.

Watch-outs

  • When in doubt about a code, category, or location, ask your engagement consultant before you submit.
